summary_en: Aisan Industry executed a share buyback of up to 2.7 million shares at a fixed price of 2,163 yen per share on November 17, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, representing 4.7% of outstanding shares, with a total commitment of up to 7 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Trading System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 16, 2026, Aisan Industry announced the execution of a share buyback via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3) on November 17, 2026. The company committed to purchase up to 2.7 million shares of its own common stock at the closing price of 2,163 yen per share, representing 4.7% of outstanding shares (calculated from 57,451,110 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026, excluding treasury stock). The total purchase commitment was capped at 7 billion yen, with the order being valid for the specified trading session only. Results were to be announced after the completion of trading on November 17, 2026.
